summary: Frontend-only verification of the DRUNK PIGEONS obstacle-geometry rework. Loaded the game on iPhone-sized viewport (390x844), played multiple runs on Sunny London, Gritty Backstreet and Chippy Sunset, sampled screenshots mid-run, and reviewed obstacleGeometry.js / obstacleAppearance.js / engine.js / GameEntities.js. Visually confirmed genuine non-rectangular silhouettes (classic BUILDING pairs, HANGING top beams, TREE with round green canopy, plus the 'That lamp post came out of nowhere' death message consistent with LAMP family). The parallax 'BREADCRUMB BUILDING SOCIETY' / 'PIGEON POST EXPRESS' sponsor billboards render in the background and never block flap taps or cause collisions (verified by pigeon flying through them). Restart-confirm modal, HUD (distance/score/chips), flap-area and revive flow all wired up with expected data-testids. Score/chips increment correctly (best of 3 score / 66m / 6 chips seen across short runs). No console errors, no PAGEERRs. Not every one of the 7 non-building families was individually captured in a screenshot in this short sampled session (CRANE, SCAFFOLD, INDUSTRIAL, RAILWAY are lower-probability spawns per pickEncounter distribution) but the code path is correct and shape families do appear; longer play sessions would statistically cover them all. Segment-based collision code (hitTestSegment) shares the SAME cached geom used by StructureShape rendering, so silhouette/hitbox drift is architecturally impossible.
action_items: Optional: consider a dev/test hook exposing engine.getObstacleGeom() on window so automated tests can deterministically verify family distribution over N spawns instead of relying on visual sampling.

Minor console warnings from react-native-web deprecations ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents', 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props) — cosmetic, not blocking; consider migrating over time.
critical_code_review_comments: obstacleGeometry.buildGeometry + hitTestSegment cleanly share segments between renderer (StructureShape) and collider (engine.collides) — the silhouette/hitbox parity is enforced by construction, which is the correct fix for the reported issue.
engine.placeObstacle correctly sets mustVary on the 4th spawn if no non-building has been seen yet, satisfying the 'non-rectangular within first 4 obstacles' spec.
engine.collides uses topMargin/bottomMargin (projectionMargin) in its broad-phase X-cull so wide projecting pieces (crane jib, hanging beam that extends past the OW lane) are not skipped — good.
clampToGapEdge safety-net prevents any segment from poking past the gap-facing edge into the fair-play corridor.

Building side is intentionally left as the original full-rect collider (topFamily==='building' branch in collides()) — matches the 'scoring/speed/spacing/chips/difficulty progression BYTE-IDENTICAL' constraint.
GameEntities.ObstacleView SVG canvas is sized to the geometry's own bounding box (segBounds), so projecting pieces are never clipped — matches spec.

Passive parallax sponsor billboards live in a separate background layer with pointerEvents='none' and never appear in the obstacles[] array — cannot cause collisions or intercept flap taps. Verified visually.

Minor: obstacleAppearance.pickEncounter uses a single Math.random() and multiple range checks — logic is correct but the mustVary branch shifts r to [0.52,1.0) which excludes the 52% classic-pair band, guaranteeing variety as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified obstacle geometry rework at 390x844. The pigeon dies at ~15m if flapped every 260ms (flies into ceiling); use ~500-600ms flap intervals for longer runs (best distance 66m, score 3 achieved). data-testids present: flap-area, restart-button, restart-confirm-overlay, restart-confirm-yes, distance-hud, score-hud, chip-hud, heckler, game-pigeon. For statistical family-distribution verification, expose engine.getObstacleGeom() on window in dev mode to sample o.topFamily/o.bottomFamily deterministically without relying on visual screenshot sampling.
